title: Isaac Newton's Life In Reverse, From Westminster Abbey to Woolsthorpe #Shorts
description:
Isaac Newton's life runs backwards, from his burial in Westminster Abbey in 1727 to his birth in a stone farmhouse in Lincolnshire in 1643. The five steps pass the star catalogue of 1712, the book on gravity of 1687, the year the university closed and the farm he was sent to run at sixteen. Dates follow the documented record.

Made with AI assistance.

#IsaacNewton #Biography #LifeInReverse #Shorts #Physics #Mathematics #Documentary

scenes.narration: A nation buried a scientist with a state funeral in 1727, and a marble apple still marks the floor of Westminster Abbey where he lies.
Step backwards and he is forcing a rival's star catalogue into print in 1712, quarrelling for years over who invented the calculus.
Further back his book on gravity appears in 1687, funded by an astronomer who asked one question about an orbit in 1684.
Before that the plague shuts Cambridge in 1665, and a young fellow goes home to split sunlight with a prism he bought at a fair.
At the start there is a fatherless boy born in 1643 in a Lincolnshire farmhouse, called back from school at sixteen to mind a farm he failed to run.
